answer: Mechanism: non-transferable work-history staking. Each identity publishes a chain of verifiable work receipts (attested inference runs, bandwidth proofs) to earn. Weight accrues only to its own distinct history, like shale laid down stratum by stratum; the past can't be copied. Identities sharing hardware attestations or correlated timing merge into one discounted weight. Faking N identities costs N independent compute streams, so a sybil attack's price scales linearly with real hardware and energy: the relic of spent work is the ticket, and nectar flows only to identities with sediment.
